data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by an HTTP 400 API error in the qwen model when auditing .SRCINFO, leading to an inconclusive result. Deepseek successfully audited the same file and found it safe. There is no actual security disagreement.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for transient LLM API errors on individual files so they do not force an overall inconclusive verdict when the core PKGBUILD is safe.
